description: The agent must: (1) Read project-context.md to identify the company as TaskFlow Pro and locate the competitor data file. (2) Parse the messy Excel file (workspace/seo/competitor_data_raw.xlsx) which has a blank row at the top of the data sheet, a metadata 'Export_Info' sheet, the main 'Competitor_Data' sheet (startrow=2), and a 'SERP_Overlap' sheet — extracting all competitor metrics. (3) Consult the SKILL.md which defines a strict 7-section Report Structure Reference: Executive Summary (with exactly top 3 findings + top 3 recommendations), Competitor Overview (with category, market position, key strength columns), Product Comparison (feature vs Us vs Competitors), SWOT Analysis (strengths/weaknesses/opportunities/threats + competitor deep dives), Marketing & Messaging (value prop, target audience, key channels), Gaps & Opportunities (gap, opportunity, priority), and Prioritized Recommendations (recommendation, impact, effort, owner). (4) The report must cover at least 3 research types from the skill: keyword/topic gap, content gap, backlink link-gap, and pricing. (5) The proprietary trap is the exact 7-section structure with precise field requirements — especially the 'top 3' constraint in Executive Summary and the 4-field structure (impact/effort/owner) in Prioritized Recommendations. A generic agent would produce a free-form analysis without these exact structural requirements.
